name: localocr
description: Connect Claude Code to your LocalOCR server: browse scans from the iPhone app, read OCR text and scenario JSON, classify with Jev, and manage scenario templates over MCP.

server_url.title: LocalOCR server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of your LocalOCR server, without a trailing slash (for example https://localocr-server-production.up.railway.app).

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: One of the keys in the server's API_KEYS variable.
